summary: b2-map built every map item of brief 2, plus decision 10 (focus by zooming) and the coordinator's correction. (1) I4 lib/fireBounds.ts: the box is the burned area, the latest perimeter, the P90 reach and the reported point together, grown by 40 %, 3 km minimum, kept inside the AOI; without mapped data, 2.5 acreage-circle radii around the point. (2) O-R4 map/framing.ts: a pure goalFor() plus a Framing state machine that MapController drives. One flight when the data is ready (it waits for the fire rasters, at most 6 s). A first load keeps a deep-linked or restored view. A fit counts as framed only when it completes. Fits that non-user calls interrupt are re-issued once the camera is free (at most 4 times); a user gesture or an explicit request ends framing. The padding is set before each fit, with an easeTo fallback. A re-fit runs when the layout settles within 2 s, so reduced motion lands on the same view. (3) O-R5: the fire is framed instead of the AOI (Eaton z11.58, was z10.69), and the 'Incident' button toggles between the fire and the modeled area ('California' on the overview). (4) O-R2 map/overviewLayers.ts: markers from shell's overviewFires(). Circles are 4-13 px by sqrt(acres): active fires filled orange with a white ring, others hollow amber, with a casing. Labels 'Name · acres' for active fires and fires of 20,000 ac or more, decluttered by collision. A hit circle of at least 22 px. California is fitted in the safe area (z5.24 desktop). (5) I3 hit-test: a marker or label opens the card (setFireCard) and flies to the fire. Inside a fire, its own marker, label or hit circle opens its card. A click on the empty map closes the card and selects the point. (6) O-R10/O-R12: the map renders the effective basemap. When USGS fails (4 errors and no tile, or no tile within 8 s while the tab is visible), it calls setBasemapFallback('dark'): all USGS requests stop and a notice offers 'Try aerial again'. Past z16.5, a note says 'Photo detail ends here'. (7) O-R11: an aerial theme with dark casings under the AOI and perimeter lines, 12 px labels with 1.6 px halos, major roads at 0.45 alpha, and from z13 a lighter observed fill (the edge stays bright) and fainter, outline-only detection squares. The photo date ('Aerial photos: USDA/USGS, June 2024 or earlier: taken before this fire') appears in the legend and the basemap menu. (8) O-R13: one muted fill-extrusion per basemap (#4a5566 / #a8a095 / #c3c9d1, opacity 0.6, fading in from z14.5 to z15), below the labels, in 3D only. Liberty's own extrusion is dropped, and overlays are inserted below the buildings (overlayBeforeId). The legend gives the decision 8 caveat. (9) O-R14: in 3D an orbit row (rotate ±15°, tilt ±10°, Top-down, North up), a one-time gesture hint, and Shift + arrow keys listed in the canvas label. (10) I6: mountOfficialLayers is mounted with official-web's stacking and removed before map.remove(). (11) Decision 10, map/focus.ts and map/nearbyPerimeters.ts: once the camera settles (300 ms, never during a gesture, flight or opening framing), the prepared fire nearest the centre whose area meets the central half of the view is focused at zoom 8.5 or more, through focusIncidentFromMap(id). It stays focused while zoom is 7 or more and it is in view, unless the user pans onto another prepared fire; below 7 the map returns to the overview. Candidates are ALL prepared fires in the live, 2026 and 2025 lists, whatever the filter. A zoom focus never moves the camera (incidentSource 'zoom'). Markers show at every zoom: dimmed while a fire is open, without the open fire's own marker, and in a past fire's replay without fires that started after the timeline time. Other prepared fires in view (zoom 7 or more, at most 8) show their latest perimeter as a lighter dashed outline: manifest and perimeters.json are fetched once per bundle version, and in a replay the outline is the perimeter published by the timeline time. Unprepared fires near the view centre (zoom 9 or more, at most 2) get a chip 'Spread not prepared yet · Prepare analysis (1-3 min)' that opens the card and never builds. CONTRACT 13 'map' sub-heading written.

Browser checks (API 8711 with FIRE3D_LIVE=0, Vite 5181, built fires only, no build triggered: 0 non-GET requests in the focus run). Opening camera, using a copy of the audit's probe: Eaton deep link ends at z11.58 -118.088,34.199 in 3 of 3 runs (the audit had the AOI at z10.69). With ?view=-118.10,34.19,13.5 and the live list delayed 1.5 s or the incident delayed 2 s, the view stays z13.50 in 5 of 5 runs (the audit lost it). With bundle JSON delayed 2 s and rasters delayed 3 s: 1 flight, same camera. Mid-flight interruptions (interrupt.mjs): compass during Eaton -> Palisades ends on the clean Palisades fit (z11.10-11.16 at -118.592,34.079; the audit stopped 34 km off); zoom-in ends at fit +1 (z12.52/12.58); a drag gives 'user' with no re-frame; a 3D switch ends with pitch 58 at the fit (this exposed a bug, fixed: the padding re-issue happened mid-ease). Reduced motion: same camera (z11.57/11.58), 2 move events against 75-86. Overview: z5.24 at 1440x900 with padding equal to the safe insets; the phone fits California between the controls and the peek sheet. Hit-test (hits.mjs): a Henderson marker opens the card with no selection and flies to z10.72; a Biscar label opens its card; Eaton's own marker opens its card; an empty click closes the card and selects the point. Fallback: ?mapfail=imagery gives dark (basemapFallback 'dark', USGS source removed) plus the notice with 'Try aerial again'. With USGS tiles held (slowusgs.mjs), the fallback comes about 8 s after the aerial style loaded, with 0 imagery requests afterwards. Alignment (align.mjs): 0 mismatched pixels and 0 edge mismatches for the observed and forecast canvases on Eaton, Palisades, Madre (zone 11), Cooley and fixture-live (zone 10); re-run after the last changes on Eaton, Cooley and fixture-live: still 0. Guarantees (guarantees.mjs): idle 3 s gives 0 renders and 0 overlay runs; 5 s of playback gives 43 runs (max 40.6 ms), then 0 when idle; selection, time, observed pixel count and forecast classes are unchanged across 3D and dark/roads/aerial; the official (7) and overview (7) layers are re-added after each swap; buildings are visible in 3D only. Decision 10 (focus.mjs): at z8 between Eaton and Palisades nothing is focused and 3 outlines show. At z9.6 over Eaton, Eaton is focused with incidentSource 'zoom', the camera is unchanged, 28,307 burned pixels draw and the time is at the latest observation. Panning to Palisades switches the focus; at z6.8 the map returns to the overview without moving. With the default 2026-season filter at z10 over Altadena, Eaton (2025) focuses (unit test and browser). Near Timber at z9.5 there is 1 chip, and its click opens the card with 0 non-GET requests. Count-only secret scan: 0 occurrences in 96 files. All 16 final screenshots viewed.
contract_deviations: I4: fireBounds(input) returns LonLatBox | null: null when there is no grid, mapped data or reported point. It takes an extra optional 'acres' input, used only without mapped data (2.5 acreage-circle radii, at least 3 km, from O-R2). aoiBounds(grid) and useMapRuntime.fireBounds are additive.

I3: on top of setFireCard(id), a marker or label click also requests a fly to the fire (fireFlyTo, decision 1 'clicking a fire flies to its full area'; shell's CONTRACT 13 allows it). Chips and other fires' outlines open the card without moving the camera.
Decision 10 replaces the first design, which showed overview markers only with no incident open: markers now show at every zoom, dimmed while a fire is open.
O-R12 'photo detail ends here': shown above z16.5 (USGS serves up to level 16). The map's max zoom stays 18.5 rather than being capped.
Focus candidates come from all three lists (the coordinator's correction), not the overview filter. Other fires' outlines also come from all lists; markers and chips follow the filter.
known_issues: The USGS imagery has voids (for example a dark disc over Edwards AFB at z8, dark ocean blocks): this is the provider's data, not a map layer (verified by hiding the imagery layer).
Southern California at z5: hollow markers overlap. Labels declutter by collision and clicks resolve to the nearest marker centre; there is no clustering.
cameraForBounds ignores pitch, so in 3D the fit frames the fire as if top-down (more of the far side shows). This was already the behaviour.
At z16+ in 3D, MapLibre warns 'cannot calculate elevation if elevation maxzoom > source.maxzoom' (Mapterhorn DEM to z16). The audit saw it without the buildings too.

The zoom-focus rule also applies to explicitly opened fires: zooming below 7, or panning the open fire out of view with no prepared fire central, returns to the overview (decision 10). A drag during an opening flight that leaves the fire out of view therefore closes it.

Honest replay: while a past fire is open, fires that started after the timeline time are hidden (markers and outlines). For example, Palisades' only perimeter (Jan 12) does not show in the Eaton replay, which ends Jan 10.
On desktop the one-time 3D gesture hint covers the top of the updates panel for up to 12 s (dismissible, then it never shows again in that browser).
Focus delay is about 0.6 s after the camera settles: the map waits 300 ms, then the store debounces 300 ms.
notes_for_integrator: 1) useWorkspace.returnToIncident() (shell, state/workspace.ts) still frames the AOI box through requestMapFlyTo, and location's SearchBox calls it. To frame the fire itself, call useMapRuntime.getState().actions?.frameFire(), for example a one-line delegation inside returnToIncident with a fallback to the AOI request when the map is not mounted. The map's own 'Incident' button and the 'Return to incident' notice already use frameFire. 2) The map frames a new incident unless useStore.incidentSource === 'zoom' (shell's field, read in the same update). Explicit opens (card, link, search, history) are framed. 3) Focus candidates are read from catalog.live, catalog.season and catalog.historical, so all three lists must stay loaded (shell). Markers and chips use overviewFires(catalog, overviewFilter). 4) Eaton deep links now open at z11.58 (fire bounds) instead of z10.69 (AOI): update any script or test that expects the old zoom. Wait for useMapRuntime.getState().framing === 'done' rather than a fixed delay. 5) Screenshot scripts: localStorage 'fire3d.orbitHintSeen' = '1' hides the one-time 3D hint; ?mapfail=imagery (dev only) simulates a USGS failure. 6) Official layers are mounted exactly as official-web documents. MapLegend and MapAttribution take the NWS entries and credits through useExtrasLegend and useExtrasCredits with no extra wiring. 7) Dev handles: __mapRuntime.getState().framing / framedKind / fireBounds / actions / overlays.nearby, and __mapStats.fits. 8) The map toolbar (.fxm-ctl) now has position: relative; z-index: 4 so its hint hangs above the updates panel. Shell's layout CSS needs no change. 9) Scratch check scripts, if the final check wants to reuse them: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-georgezhou-Desktop-Project-Fire-3d/99f59d94-2458-4953-9842-bb4025668b7f/scratchpad/v7/map/ (probe.mjs, interrupt.mjs, hits.mjs, guarantees.mjs, focus.mjs, slowusgs.mjs, motion.mjs, align.mjs, finals.sh).
